evidence.summary:
Inventory re-established, and the task's own line count needs one correction: this package has 7 SERIALIZATION sites, not 9. The grep returns 15 lib/ hits, but 14 of those are the 7 createdAt/updatedAt PAIRS (each site is two adjacent lines) and the 15th is macro_service.dart:264 `now.toIso8601String()`, which renders the {{iso_date}} macro into prompt TEXT for the model. That one is not a persisted instant and is deliberately excluded from this change.

Confirmed at the exact lines named: already UTC at character_entities.dart:181-182 and :231-232, worldbook_entities.dart:112-113. Were bare at prompt_profile.dart:96-97, prompt_manager.dart:893-894, regex_profile.dart:132-133, regex_script.dart:255-256.

NOTE ON CURRENT STATE: all four bare sites are ALREADY normalized in HEAD (commit a515b76 'fix: serialize persisted instants on a UTC basis'), so re-running this grep today shows 7/7 carrying .toUtc(). The pre-fix split was reconstructed by checking out a515b76~1 for those four files, which is also what produced the section-2 failure evidence.
